# H entitlement before route

## The heuristic

**Check what the account is actually owed before choosing the route. Entitlement bounds what may be promised on the way up as well as on the way in.**


_Why:_ Escalation is where over-promising happens, because the escalating agent is trying to restore confidence and the receiver has not yet read the contract. A commitment made during an escalation is the hardest one to walk back.
